name: Material React Table · Basic Example

title.zh: Material React Table · 先用 Basic 表格确认所

description.zh: 五条记录与表格工具栏、分页 Material React Table 把 TanStack Table 的表格逻辑与 Material UI 的界面结合成 React 数据表格。官网按过滤、排序、编辑、分组和虚拟滚动等任务组织指南，安装页说明依赖版本。Basic 示例完整呈现五条记录、列标题、工具栏和分页区域；可从单一表格组件入手，再按业务需求选择功能或自定义子组件。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Material React Table (https://www.material-react-table.com/).
Technology stack: react, typescript, javascript.
Component specification: 五条记录与表格工具栏、分页


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
